name: magenxcommerce/module-ai-mcp
description: Serves a Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint from Magento so an AI agent such as Claude Code can inspect and manage the backend: products with their images, links, variants, bundle options, downloadable links and custom options, categories, orders with their addresses, invoices, shipments and their tracking numbers, credit memos, customers, admin users, stock, tier prices, cart and catalog price rules, CMS pages and blocks, widgets, e-mail templates, design configuration and the media gallery, product attributes and attribute sets, URL rewrites, return requests, help desk tickets, store configuration, caches, indexers and cron. Authenticated with a Magento Integration access token and authorized against that integration's own ACL role; disabled by default, writes opt-in.
